mechanism: The great displacement is old: the field lost more than half its height in mid-2025 with clustered channel deaths, and for the last twenty-two sessions price has sat motionless near 18.3 while the lanes re-knit at S_UF 0.80-0.92. Long-lane stability has sagged to life lows (0.64-0.75) and the final session ends with one channel dying and URF pinned at 0.000, so the base carries a fresh crack, but no new displacement has arrived and there are no ignitions -- the field is absorbing, not collapsing. Stored tension is real yet undirected; the floor has held for a full month and a downward claim has nothing to push against yet.
